That person is seen mainly from the torso downward in a gray top and olive trousers, faces generally toward the work area and camera wearer, and their gaze cannot be determined because their head is out of view. Across the five frames, the wearer’s hands remain on the hose while the ground, tree, scattered objects, and other person sweep laterally through the image, indicating rotation or turning rather than a clear approach or retreat.
